title: Unit 4 Consolidation: Guatemala
goal: Review Tikal, the Popol Vuh, Antigua, the armed conflict and its memory, and community life in the highlands, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: passive with ser, antes de / después de + infinitive, a pesar de, reported speech

items: I can review what I learned about Guatemala, from Tikal to the highlands today.
I can use the passive with *ser*, *antes de* and *después de* + infinitive, *a pesar de* and reported speech.
I can put events from the classic Maya to 1999 in order.
I can cite a source with *según* when I talk about the armed conflict.
I can say who built or explored a monument with the passive with *ser*.
I can tell events in order with *antes de* and *después de* + infinitive.
I can say that something lasted in spite of difficulties, with *a pesar de* and *pese a*.
I can report what a commission or a witness said, with *dijo que* and *según*.
